They’re not rushed—they’re focused. And when they’re on a project site in Houston or Scottsdale, they always carry a small toolkit with a fine-tip pen, a pocket-sized contract checklist, and a reusable water bottle with the Quanta logo they got as a gift during a site visit last year.
A bias towards liking the particular company or being a consumer of the company (maybe affiliation bias?)
